_about: The Closer (studied from 5 top Hormozi Shorts, frame by frame): whole phrase in ALL CAPS on a solid yellow box on the chest, a new caption every ~1 s, the frame changes every ~2.4 s (punch-ins alternate two framings, bigger on emphasis words), a whoosh on every 3rd, no music, no scenes.

director.style: The Closer: keep WHOLE SENTENCES. Never cut inside a sentence and never trim a sentence's first or last word - a half-sentence breaks this look outright. Drop a sentence entirely rather than shortening it. The picture changes about every 2.4 s, alternating two framings and going bigger on the emphasis word.
director.restraint: Nothing is added to the frame. The whole look is the caption box and the punch-ins: no scenes, no pages, no cards, no icons, no B-roll, no stickers, no banner. If nothing is genuinely needed, return empty lists and say so in the summary.
